instance.name: qap10-extension14
instance.construction: QAP10 intacto; nuevos flujos muestreados de sus 45 pares (incluye ceros); cuadrícula de 4 columnas, Manhattan ×2
instance.source: data/qap10_matrices.json; extensión sintética del equipo, no un benchmark MIPLIB oficial ni datos aeroportuarios medidos

measurement.execution: isolated processes, serial jobs; same imports before each timed solver
measurement.time_scope: solver call including warm start/trace validation, excluding imports and JSON writing
measurement.memory_scope: sampled process RSS during solver call, 5 ms interval; includes Python and all imported libraries
measurement.memory_limit: Sampling can miss transient peaks; baseline and increase provided, not memory of a real QPU
measurement.comparison: Same seeded start and flight-neighbourhood sequence for paired LNS methods; same 60-step budget, not same wall-time budget
